cohort_total_n_excerpt: Two hundred four patients with prostate cancer and 102 healthy controls were recruited into a hospital-based case control study.
reason: The abstract evaluates prostate cancer overall in patients and healthy controls but does not analyze an aggressive incident prostate cancer endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: An age adjusted logistic regression limited to controls and patients not receiving bisphosphonate therapy showed that higher corrected serum calcium and the VDR Bb/BB genotypes independently increased the risk of prostate cancer.
estimate_classifications.reason: The estimate concerns prostate cancer overall; no aggressive subtype is specified.
